blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former presidential spokesperson Harry Roque’s asylum bid was “neither approved or disapproved,” Camarines Sur Rep. Arnie Fuentebella said on Tuesday. He echoed Roque’s defense that his request has yet to be resolved. Fuentebella said that Roque’s asylum request had already passed the normal six-month course, though he did not clarify whether the application remains pending, nor specify the country where he is seeking safe haven. “[The] normal course is six months. It passed already, neither approved or disapproved,” he told lawmakers, reading from a handout. Fuentebella was defending the Department of Interior and Local Government’s (DILG) spending plan […]...
